sentences.text: Ms. Megha Jain - Advocate for the applicants.

Shri K K Tiwari - GA appearing on behalf of Advocate General.
 Shri Sevakram Gujar - Advocate for the respondent/objector/Smt  Shri Vijay Kumar Dubey- Advocate of the complainant/Mohammad A  Usmani.
 ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2] This is the first application filed by the applicants under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail as they are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.199/2025 registered at Police Tilak Nagar Indore (Urban) District Indore for the offence punishable under Sections 34, 406 and 420 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Tilak Nagar Indore (Urban) District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3] The allegation against the applicants is of fraud.

4] Counsel for the applicants has submitted that a settlement has already been arrived at between the parties out of the Court as the complainant/Santosh W/o Shri Vijay Sikarwar has no objection if the present application is allowed,
and it is also submitted that otherwise also the main allegations are againt co-accused Govardhan Shukla, who had transacted the same land with some other persons which was already gifted by him through registered gift deed to the applicant no.1/Janki Shukla and Mohammad Ali Gummu Baksh Usmani.

Thus, it is submitted that the custodial interrogation NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21334 2 MCRC-32394-2025 of the applicants is not necessary as the applicants Smt. Janaki Shukla vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89109094/
1 are women, and the anticipatory bail application be allowed.

entities.text: Janaki Shukla vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5] Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer.
6] Shri Sevakram Gujar, counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant, has no objection if the application is allowed.
7] Shri Vijay Kumar Dubey- Advocate on behalf of the complainant/Mohammad Ali Gummu Baksh Usmani has also opposed the prayer.

8] Having considered the rival submissions, on perusal of the case diary, the objection filed by the objector and under the facts and circumstances of the case, the custodial interrogation of the applicants does not appear necessary as the main allegations are against the co-accused Govardhan Shukla.
9] Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicants shall be released on bail, upon their executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) each and furnishing one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicants shall make themself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
They shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
10] Accordingly, MCRC stands allowed.
